concern: Urdu چیزیں (plural) ... تھیں (plural aux) but Roman uses singular "thi" instead of the corpus's own plural form "thin" (used elsewhere e.g. 7:20 "posheeda thin"). Number agreement lost.
suggestion: aas paas ki cheezen roshni mein aayi hi thin ke Allah un ke noor ko le gaya...

concern: گھیرنے (to surround/encircle) is romanised "ghairne", colliding with the unrelated common word غیر "ghair" (other/without). Every other occurrence of this verb in the corpus (gher, ghere, gherne, gheri, gherega, ghera - 29 total) uses "gher-", not "ghair-"; this is the corpus's only "ghairne".
suggestion: Aur Allah Taala kaafiron ko gherne wala hai.

concern: Urdu روشن دلیلیں دیں ("gave clear proofs") - same construction as 45:17, where the owner ruled (Q21) دیں should be "dein", not "din" (which reads as "day"). 45:17 was fixed to "daleelein dein" but this verse still has "daleelen din".
suggestion: aur hum ne (Hazrat) Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ko roshan daleelen dein aur Rooh-ul-Qudus se...
